Cosmos DB shared database autoscale max throughput in RU/s for the Dapr state containers. Autoscale bursts to this ceiling during backup commits (the per-file state writes exceed a fixed 400 RU/s and get 429-throttled) and idles at 10% of it. NOTE: the Cosmos account (an existing resource, not managed here) carries a totalThroughputLimit guardrail — currently 4000 RU/s — which must stay above this value; autoscale migration transiently requires ~2x headroom.
